messages:
maya: Quick sync — small docs push to align naming voice for model types (core vs variant) and to tidy a couple of SDK snippets. @liam @alex can you triage? Goal: one canonical glossary entry + a short JS migration snippet. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/342 — please add comments by EOD.

liam: On it. Quick Q: do we prefer 'model variant' (singular) or 'model variants' (plural) in headings? leaning singular for glossary.

alex: I vote 'model variant' as canonical term. Add aliases in parentheses on first mention. I'll update the glossary and drop a small batching snippet for the JS SDK.

sarah: Tiny reminder — keep SDK examples compact (<6 lines) and prefer async/await. E.g. use `await client.text.generate(...)` not callbacks. Also prefer backticks for inline values.

liam: Also let's standardize model ID casing. We have examples like `Redwood/GPT-2B` and `redwood/gpt-2b` floating around. Recommend canonical lowercase with hyphens/slashes. Should we add a migration note?

maya: Yes — migration note needed. We decided earlier to standardize on lowercase model IDs (e.g., `redwood/gpt-2b`). Add a before/after snippet to the PR showing the change. Also add a one-liner in the SDK migration guide.

alex: Pushed a draft snippet in the PR, here's the example I'm proposing:

```
// Before
const resp = await client.generate({ model: "Redwood/GPT-2B", prompt });

// After (canonical)
const resp = await client.generate({ model: "redwood/gpt-2b", prompt });
```

liam: Nice, that will be easy to grep/fix in other docs. I'll also add a note in the migration guide about normalizing `model` values when upgrading.

docs-bot: Preview built: https://deploy-preview-342--docs.redwood.com — checks passed (:white_check_mark:)

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks. There are 4 broken links flagged by CI in the glossary page — can someone take link fixes? The CI log points to anchors for `runtime-choices.md` and `sdk-snippets#batching`.

alex: I'll fix the `runtime-choices.md` anchor and the SDK snippet anchor now. Pushing a tiny commit to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abcdef1

sarah: I'll review the PR this afternoon. If it's just glossary + tiny snippets we can merge with one approver.

liam: If merged, do we want a CHANGELOG entry? It's mostly editorial. I think no, but add a line in the migration guide release notes.

maya: Plan: merge after 1 approving review + green preview. I'll do final pass. Target merge: today 5pm PT. If anyone wants to take ownership of the follow-ups (sdk lint rule suggestion, more examples), @mention me and I'll reassign.

alex: Taking link-fixes + glossary edit now.

sarah: I'll do the final content review post-merge for any microcopy tweaks.

maya: Great — thanks everyone.
